overview_description.description: Axelrod provides an operating layer for boutique, independent, and resort hotels. Its service coordinates operational work across guests, rooms, hotel teams, owners, and booking channels while connecting with existing property management systems, communication tools, pricing systems, accounting software, and other operational platforms. Axelrod supports workflows involving arrivals, room operations, rates, access, maintenance, supplies, messaging, and owner reporting.
